title: Practice 31: On Wednesday, in that minute, the next day: в and на + accusative

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Хороша борьба: как молоко, в ___ (один день) свернулась!
exercises.why: «В + Accusative is used: (a) to indicate the time of the day; (b) to indicate the day of the week; (c) to indicate how frequently something occurs.» «Note also the following expressions: В минуту опасности. В годы войны. Во время войны. В первый раз. В следующий раз. В последний раз.» «Units smaller than a week (day, hour etc.) take „В + Acc.“» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 19 and 73.  ·  *Антон Чехов, «Несчастье»*
exercises.context: В + Accusative is used to indicate the time of the day, the day of the week, and how frequently something occurs. (DLI, Lessons 19 and 73)
